title: Lathi can stop a crowd, but not a question: Rahul Gandhi
content:
Rahul said thousands of youngsters were protesting peacefully against 'vote chori' and the resignation of CEC Kumar to save democracy, but the Modi-Shah government replied by dragging the boys and girls through the streets and arresting them.

NEW DELHI: Slamming the police action on protests against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar on Gandhi Jayanti, Congress Lok Sabha MP Rahul Gandhi on Friday said the CEC will ultimately be forced out, as would be the system that appointed him. “He will go. Because a lathi can stop a crowd, but not a question,” the leader of the opposition said. On X, Rahul said thousands of youngsters were protesting peacefully against “vote chori” and the resignation of CEC Kumar to save democracy, but the Modi-Shah government replied by dragging the boys and girls through the streets and arresting them. “That is what Bapu taught us – speak the truth and fight peacefully. And that is what scares the govt the most,” he added.

End of Article

title: Drew Barrymore family’s former LA estate sells for $14.7 million after 6 years
content: built in the late 1920s by architect John Byers, the estate occupies just under an acre in the prestigious post office neighbourhood of Beverly Hills . the spanish Colonial compound has now changed hands for $14.7 million, adding another filmmaker to a property already woven into the story of American cinema .

title: 'I am Hanuman to Rahul Gandhi': Ajay Rai after being replaced as UP Congress chief
content: former UPCC president ajay Rai called himself a 'Hanuman' to Congress leader Rahul Gandhi . he said he would continue to follow the party's national leadership and carry out its political fight . Rai also recalled his contest against prime minister Narendra Modi in 2024 elections .

title: Narco kingpin Navpreet Singh deported from Türkiye to India
content: narco-trafficking kingpin Navpreet Singh was deported from Türkiye . he was formally taken into custody by intelligence and law enforcement agencies . the deportation struck a major blow against international illicit drug networks .

title: Unsolicited advice to Supreme Court lands trial judge in trouble
content: the court expressed shock over its contents, which were uncalled for . it directed its registry to ask the judge why he wrote what he said . the case pertains to the bail petition of an accused from west Bengal . apex court had asked the trial court to complete the proceedings within three months .

title: Flydubai co-pilot identified; was barred from flying in Oman over 'extremist views'
content: alleged views are being examined as part of a wider investigation into possible Islamic radicalisation and terrorist motives . alhamami was barred from flying in Oman over concerns about his alleged extremist views . revelations follow a report that he had been removed from a training role at Oman Air .

title: US woman kills 4-yr-old, then shoots self dead after losing custody battle to ex-husband
content: a court granted primary custody of her daughter, Vivian, to her ex-husband . instead, she fatally shot the child at their home before turning the gun on herself . she was taken to a hospital but died a day later, police said .

title: Rahul launches 'Satyagraha' website for information on current protests across India
content: 'Satyagraha' is a digital platform aimed at consolidating information on various issue-based protests taking place across the country . the website was launched a day after the 157th birth anniversary of Mahatma Gandhi .
